about: One map of the Authentication settings an environment can hold. Read by src/control/auth-config.ts and checked against lab/auth_settings.py by lab/test_auth_config_registry.py. Key names are the platform config names the pinned Studio carries (docs/evidence/auth-config-study-2026-10-30/study.json); each becomes the GOTRUE_ variable of the same name. A key has one owner file. A default is listed only where this repository sets it; JWT_EXP has none here (the pinned Auth applies its own), so it shows null_text. A setting with emit_suffix is saved as a whole number and reaches Auth with that suffix (a Go duration).

retired.SECURITY_REFRESH_TOKEN_ROTATION_ENABLED: live check 2026-10-30: with the switch off a refresh still gave a new refresh token, so the setting has no effect
retired.SECURITY_REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSE_INTERVAL: live check 2026-10-30: a reused token was refused the same way with the interval at 0, 1 and the default
retired.RATE_LIMIT_TOKEN_REFRESH: live check 2026-10-30: the limit applies only when a client address header is configured, and the gateway sets none
retired.RATE_LIMIT_ANONYMOUS_USERS: live check 2026-10-30: the limit applies only when a client address header is configured, and the gateway sets none
retired.RATE_LIMIT_WEB3: live check 2026-10-30: the limit applies only when a client address header is configured, and the gateway sets none

core.label: Allow manual linking
core.evidence: json tag manual_linking_enabled with default false in the pinned Auth binary (SecurityConfiguration)

core.label: Allow new users to sign up
Enforce single session per user
core.hint: If enabled, all but a user's most recently active session will be terminated.
core.evidence: json tag single_per_user in the pinned Auth binary

core.label: Prevent use of leaked passwords
core.hint: Rejects the use of known or easy to guess passwords on sign up or password change. Auth checks the Have I Been Pwned range service, so this environment gets outbound network access while it is on.
core.evidence: HIBP structures in the pinned Auth binary; the name PASSWORD_HIBP_ENABLED comes from the Studio schema only

core.label: Minimum password length
core.hint: Passwords shorter than this are rejected on sign up and password change. Auth hashes at most 72 bytes of a password, so the highest value is 72.
core.evidence: json tag min_length in the pinned Auth binary; the name PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH comes from the Studio schema only. Maximum 72: the bcrypt limit, not read from the binary.

core.label: Maximum number of per-user MFA factors
core.hint: How many MFA factors can be enrolled at once per user.
core.evidence: MaxEnrolledFactors split_words default 10 in the pinned Auth binary

core.label: Allow people to add an authenticator app (TOTP)
core.hint: Turn this off to stop new TOTP factors being enrolled. Existing factors keep working while verification stays on.
core.evidence: json tag enroll_enabled in the pinned Auth binary; default true in the same binary tag

core.label: Allow people to verify with an authenticator app (TOTP)
core.hint: Turn this off to stop TOTP codes being accepted. Use with care: people who rely on them cannot pass a second factor.
core.evidence: json tag verify_enabled in the pinned Auth binary; default true in the same binary tag

core.label: Enable SAML 2.0 Single Sign-On
core.hint: Let people sign in through their company's SAML identity provider. The first time you turn it on, the console makes this environment's signing key and keeps it, because identity providers trust its certificate.
core.evidence: live check 2026-10-30: GOTRUE_SAML_ENABLED with a PKCS#1 key shows saml_enabled in Auth's settings and the admin API manages providers

core.label: Write audit logs to the database
core.hint: Auth records sign-ins and account changes in its audit table. Off stops new entries; the entries already there stay.
core.evidence: live check 2026-10-30: GOTRUE_AUDIT_LOG_DISABLE_POSTGRES=true left the audit table empty after a sign-up

core.label: Customize Access Token (JWT) Claims
core.hint: Customize the claims in the access token Auth issues.
core.evidence: live check 2026-10-30: HOOK_CUSTOM_ACCESS_TOKEN_ENABLED and _URI with a Postgres function added a claim to the token; the other hooks use the same naming and were not tried

core.label: Confirm email
core.hint: People must confirm their email address before signing in for the first time. Without custom SMTP this environment sends no email, so a confirmation can only arrive through a Send Email hook.
core.evidence: live check 2026-10-30 (lab/auth-names-check.py mail_settings, docs/evidence/settings-routes-2026-10-30/mail-settings-names.json): set through the sign-in settings with no mail file, false left a new user unconfirmed and sent the confirmation mail

core.label: Rate limit for sending emails
core.hint: Emails Auth may send per hour from this environment. Applied only while Confirm email is on.
core.evidence: live check 2026-10-30 (mail_settings): set to 1 through the sign-in settings, the second mail was refused with over_email_send_rate_limit

core.label: Rate limit for sign-in emails
core.hint: Sign-up, recovery, magic link and one-time code requests in 5 minutes, counted for the whole environment.
core.evidence: live check 2026-10-30 (mail_settings): set to 1, no refusal was seen on /magiclink or /otp, with or without a client address header; the name is the one the mail file always used, and its effect is not shown

core.label: Rate limit for token verifications
core.hint: OTP and magic link verifications in 5 minutes, counted for the whole environment.
core.evidence: live check 2026-10-30 (mail_settings): set to 1, no refusal was seen on POST /verify, with or without a client address header; the name is the one the mail file always used, and its effect is not shown

core.label: Minimum interval per user
core.hint: The shortest time between two emails sent to the same person.
core.evidence: live check 2026-10-30 (mail_settings): saved as 1 and sent as 1s, a resend at once was refused and one two seconds later was accepted
